claims.statement: Listed in the painters' company in 1472, recorded in Verrocchio's household in 1476, then commissioned independently in 1478 and 1481.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Company of San Luca register; Ufficiali di Notte record, 1476; commission records, 1478 and 1481.
